description: Source code implementing the ICommonClock interface and related classes for Android's media common time synchronization, including IPC transaction handling, interface definitions, and class implementations.

classes.name: BpCommonClock
classes.description: Proxy class for ICommonClock interface, handling IPC calls to remote clock service.

classes.name: BnCommonClock
classes.description: Binder class implementing ICommonClock interface, handling incoming IPC transactions.

classes.name: BpCommonClockListener
classes.description: Proxy class for ICommonClockListener, handling IPC calls for clock timeline change notifications.

classes.name: BnCommonClockListener
classes.description: Binder class implementing ICommonClockListener, handling incoming IPC transactions for timeline change events.

methods.name: isCommonTimeValid
methods.description: Checks if the common time is valid and retrieves the associated timeline ID.

methods.name: commonTimeToLocalTime
methods.description: Converts a common time value to local time.

methods.name: localTimeToCommonTime
methods.description: Converts a local time value to common time.

methods.name: getCommonFreq
methods.description: Retrieves the frequency of the common clock.

methods.name: getEstimatedError
methods.description: Gets the estimated error of the clock.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Gets the current state of the clock.

methods.name: getMasterAddr
methods.description: Retrieves the master address of the clock.

methods.name: registerListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for clock events.

methods.name: onTransact
methods.description: Handles incoming IPC transactions for ICommonClock.

methods.name: onTimelineChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when the clock timeline changes.
